ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only an action

2. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

3. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

4. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

5. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

6. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.

7. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

8. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

9. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

10. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

11. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

13. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

14. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. went
   C. goes
   D. going

15. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. blue
   C. quickly
   D. happiness

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
